dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: You're not hurt, are you? Me neither. I'm actually holding up a lot better than I expected in these fights...

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: So there's no need to worry about my safety. What's important is that you don't go putting yourself in danger on my account!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Please, trust me to protect myself and to protect you, too.
